response.overview: Gen Takasegawa (interpretato da Koji Yakusho) is a world-famous, egotistical Japanese actor and second-generation celebrity who returns to Japan from London after performing King Lear at the Globe Theatre. Upon his return, he discovers that a bizarre side effect of a pandemic vaccine has caused almost everyone in Japan to collectively forget his fame, identity, and existence.
response.tagline: "Once Japan's most renowned actor, Gen is suddenly forgotten. Fueled by a need for recognition, he claws his way back from zero in this comedy."
response.title: Did Someone Happen To Mention Me?
